description: Auto routing cases in French, Spanish, Italian and Turkish over workspace.json plus workspace-intl.json, labelled like cases.json. The probe does not stem, so a question routes to the sources by the probe only when it shares word forms with a chunk; reference phrases count with or without accents (and, in Turkish, with either i).
